title: Emenegger and Linda Moulton Howe promised footage that is then pulled

plain: Bryce Zabel, a writer talking about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes a pattern of people being promised film and then having it taken away. He says that in the 1970s and 80s a filmmaker, Robert Emenegger, and a journalist, Linda Moulton Howe, both believed they were going to get footage, and then it got pulled. For Zabel, this would show insiders dangling evidence before the public and then holding it back.
